response.overview: A rookie actress who debuted under dazzling spotlights, Yoon I-na (real name Yoon I-ji, 22, female), dies suddenly by jumping to her death. Unable to accept her sister’s death, her younger brother Yoon I-hun (18, male) begins to chase the truth hidden behind it. But at the end of his pursuit, what I-hun confronts is not the kind and gentle sister he thought he knew.  “We are exposing Yoon Ina's school violence.”  Years earlier, just before her debut as an idol, I-na lost everything because of a single email. Four years later, faced with what may be her final chance to stardom, she chooses a perilous journey: seeking out her victims and turning her apologies into transactions in an attempt to bury the past.  Na-eun, who pretends to accept I-na’s apology while exposing her unresolved trauma
response.title: Broken Flower
